inspectionScope: Decoded fixed V018 manifest and numeric payload. Measured source closed pose at bay actuator progress 0. No geometry or runtime was changed by this diagnosis.
finding: The mission does return the scalar actuator to its closed value. The visible approximately 250.75 mm longitudinal opening is already present in the source closed endpoint, so replaying the source curve cannot close it.
secondaryRobustnessFinding: MotionSystem skips actuator writes when progress differs by at most 1e-5. At very high update rates this can retain a micrometre-scale residual near an endpoint. It is too small to explain the measured centre gap, but endpoints should still be canonicalised and snapped exactly.

proposedRepair.method: Keep the outermost slat on each side fixed. Redistribute the final closure across all 15 slats per side along the existing lower-fuselage cross-section. Apply the correction only during the final latch interval of the bay actuator. Preserve the source open pose and the source path outside that interval.
proposedRepair.historicalCalibrationStatus: visual and kinematic correction pending reference confirmation; target seam is an engineering display choice, not a claimed factory tolerance

requiredTests: forward and aft centre seam at closed endpoint is at most 4 mm
outer slat boundaries remain fixed within 0.5 mm
adjacent slats do not produce new visible gaps or destructive intersections
0 to 1 to 0 and repeated mission loops return identical closed matrices
pause, seek, reset and high-refresh endpoint tests pass
animated workbench and static skin workbench share the same corrected closed pose
